title: My Samsung Empire
description: Build your own Samsung Empire in Minecraft! Launch One UI versions, earn money, unlock upgrades, and grow your tech company
body:
Start your own Samsung Empire in Minecraft! Launch new versions of One UI, manufacture Samsung devices, earn money, and buy upgrades to grow your business. The Advancements tab will guide you through the datapack.

My Samsung Empire is an unofficial Minecraft datapack inspired by Samsung products and technology.


<details>
<summary>How to Install</summary>


<details>
<summary>Windows</summary>

1. Press Edit on your world of your choice
2. Press Open World Folder
3. Put the Datapack into the datapacks folder
4. Done!

</details>

<details>
<summary>Aternos Server</summary>


<details>
<summary>Official Aternos Tutorial (Outdated)</summary>

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/ekFgQsLO5x4" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

</details>

1. Go to Files on your server page
2. Select your World,then go to [Datapacks](https://aternos.org/files/world/datapacks/)
3. Upload this Datapack in the datapacks folder
4. Restart your server (if it is Online) or do ``` /reload ```
5. Done!

</details>



</details>



<details>
<summary>Entering the Samsung Dimension</summary>

To enter the Samsung Dimension, right-click with a Samsung Portal. It can be crafted using 8 Copper Ingots and 1 Iron Nugget. You can find the recipe in the Recipe Book.

You can also enter the Samsung Dimension by Right Clicking on the particles of a Samsung Portal that generated in the world! [(2.2 Beta 1+)](https://modrinth.com/datapack/my-samsung-empire/version/b_1_2.2)

</details>

<details>
<summary>Launching a new version of One UI</summary>

Launching a new version of One UI increases your Store Quality. The higher your Store Quality, the faster customers will arrive.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Manufacturing and Selling Samsung Phones</summary>

To manufacture a Samsung Phone, enter the Samsung Dimension and press the "Make Phone" button.

You will need:
- CPU
- GPU
- Screen

  
<details>
<summary>How to obtain components</summary>
  
1. Craft them using a recipe in the Recipe Book
2. Place down a Component Farm and wait 10 minutes for the component to grow [(2.0 Beta 1+)](https://modrinth.com/datapack/my-samsung-empire/version/mIfYpOWb)
3. Find a Samsung Farm in the Overworld [(2.2 Beta 1+)](https://modrinth.com/datapack/my-samsung-empire/version/b_1_2.2)


</details>


  
To sell a phone, press the "Sell Phone" button.

You cannot sell devices if all storage slots are full. You can purchase Shelves from the Store using Money to increase your available slots. The same system applies to other devices.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Eraning Money</summary>

 You can eran Money in different ways: 

1. Sell devices and wait for customers to arrive
2. Craft Money using this recipe or an other recipe in the Recipe Book: [(1.1+)](https://modrinth.com/datapack/my-samsung-empire/version/aI2Qlfgw)
3. Kill an Apple Boss [(2.0 Beta 2+)](https://modrinth.com/datapack/my-samsung-empire/version/b_2_2.0)
4. Loot a Samsung Temple [(2.2 Beta 1+)](https://modrinth.com/datapack/my-samsung-empire/version/b_1_2.2)
   
 ![The recipe for Money](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c2293d785c1c3c5e917aa5a1a7a2ddccef5d24a9.png)
   

Money can be used to purchase upgrades, expand your business, and unlock new opportunities.
</details>
